title: Roman Numerals
prompt: Implement bidirectional Roman numeral conversion for integers in 1..3999. to_roman(n) returns the standard Roman form (subtractive notation: IV, IX, XL, XC, CD, CM). from_roman(s) parses a Roman string case-insensitively and returns the integer. Out-of-range or invalid inputs must be reported as errors (language-appropriate error type or null/None with a clear failure path).
acceptance: to_roman(0) and to_roman(4000) fail; from_roman("") and from_roman("ABC") fail
round-trip: from_roman(to_roman(n)) == n for sample values
